description:
Port the upstream pi-mono prompt composition machinery to octo_pi. The upstream assembles a system prompt from:
1. Context files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, discovered by walking upward from cwd)
2. File-based system prompt override (.pi/SYSTEM.md or ~/.pi/SYSTEM.md)
3. Append system prompt (.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md / ~/.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md — both loaded, project appended after global)
4. Skills (SKILL.md files discovered recursively in .pi/skills/ and ~/.pi/skills/, formatted as XML in system prompt)
5. Prompt templates (.md files in .pi/prompts/ and ~/.pi/prompts/, with frontmatter + bash-style arg substitution)

Our SystemPrompt.render/1 already accepts context_files, append, custom_prompt — but nothing populates them. This epic fills that gap.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/system-prompt.ts, resource-loader.ts, skills.ts, prompt-templates.ts, agent-session.ts

Dependency graph:
- context-file-discovery (1) → resource-loader-wiring (6)
- system-append-prompt-files (2) → resource-loader-wiring (6)
- skills-loading (3) → skills-xml (4) → resource-loader-wiring (6)
- prompt-templates (5) → resource-loader-wiring (6)
title: Prompt composition parity: resource loader, skills, context files, templates
